rationale.conceptual: Implementing a self-consistent Schrödinger-Poisson solver for a heterostructure requires careful handling of effective mass theory, Fermi-Dirac statistics, and iterative convergence. This is an established non-trivial method that needs a solid understanding of semiconductor device physics and numerical methods.

It uses only standard Python/numpy, no complex tooling, data fetching, or fragile handoffs. It is straightforward orchestration.
